stories.title: On 1st day since winning 3rd term as governor, Pritzker releases 200-point national agenda
stories.description: JB Pritzker released a 200-point policy plan that he wants the new Democrat-controlled Congress to take up. The plan is aimed at reversing many Trump administration policies that Pritzker believes harms Illinois.
